items.raw_excerpt: Learning Danish is difficult and requires you to make a real effort, which is why today's expression should come in handy.
items.summary_en: Learning Danish is hard, but today's phrase makes it easier. 'At gøre sig umage' means to make a real effort. It is a useful expression for anyone trying to speak Danish.

items.title_en: Danish expression of the day: at gøre sig umage

items.raw_excerpt: Coastal provinces could be hit by heavy rain, hail and even tornadoes on Thursday afternoon as the hot, dry summer weather in the Netherlands comes to an abrupt halt. The meteorological institute KNMI has issued a code yellow warning for all coastal provinces, from Groningen to Zeeland, including the Wadden Islands. The agency has warned people in the area to expect heavy showers, hail and gusts of up to 60 km/h. Tornadoes have already been spotted off the coast. The...
items.summary_en: Heavy rain, hail, and possible tornadoes are expected in the Netherlands on Thursday. The heatwave is ending with severe weather warnings for all coastal provinces. Wind gusts up to 60 kilometers per hour are forecast.
items.summary_ko: 목요일 네덜란드 해안 지역에 폭우와 우박, 최대 시속 60km의 강한 바람이 예상됩니다. 폭염이 갑작스럽게 끝나면서 KNMI가 모든 해안 지역에 코드 옐로우 경보를 발령했습니다. 해안 근처에서 이미 토네이도가 목격되었습니다.
items.title_en: Thunderstorm and tornado warnings as Dutch summer heatwave ends

items.raw_excerpt: No Centro-Oeste, há aviso laranja de perigo para baixa umidade do ar sobre grande parte de Mato Grosso, norte e leste de Mato Grosso do Sul, oeste e sul de Goiás e no DF.
items.summary_en: A cold front associated with a cyclone is lowering temperatures in southern Brazil. An orange alert for low humidity has been issued for parts of the Central-West region, including Mato Grosso and Goiás.

items.title_en: Cold front and cyclone lower temperatures in southern Brazil
